title: Woolworths Ltd - proposed acquisition of a supermarket lease in Wallaroo, South Australia.
targets: Supermarket lease in Wallaroo South Australia

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns. Proposed date for announcement of ACCC's findings amended from 3 December 2008 to 21 January 2009.
Closing date for submissions relating to Statement of Issues.
ACCC review terminated as the proposed transaction will no longer proceed for commercial reasons as between the land owner and the developer.
